use: Unmodified files served locally; no runtime font CDN request. verify.cjs asserts only these three files are ever requested.
departure: Replaces Manrope (Creator-accepted in r06). Chosen after a side-by-side spec render (Geist vs Manrope at display and UI sizes) because Geist's tighter, contemporary grotesque reads as current-generation shop design; Manrope reads friendlier but more generic at display sizes. Aesthetic recommendation for the Creator to confirm, not an objective ranking.
